answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove it ran duplicate identities. A fake army then faces a real cost: each Sybil must post collateral, so a gale of sock-puppets drains the attacker's own funds instead of flooding the market. Honest work builds a slow ripple of earned reputation that cannot be bought in bulk, while cheaters sink like water into karst - their stake vanishes into the protocol and their identities are burned.
